registration.title: WindNet Phase III: matched improvements across all four metrics
registration.question: Can image-only solar-wind forecasting improve RMSE, correlation, reduced chi-squared and the original high-speed-event threat score together under the original WindNet data and evaluation protocol, with hypotheses chosen exclusively from training-side validation?
registration.summary: New user-requested campaign continuing the matched WindNet study. Prior campaign: https://fixrelay.vercel.app/campaigns/1b7e08e2-70f1-4945-b613-5e785d3f76bb . Preserve prior records and frozen models. Start with no new experiments or claimed improvements. Use primary literature and training-side evidence only; record all hypotheses, controls, ablations, outcomes, provenance and costs. No Elicit.
registration.objective: Improve all four original WindNet H4/D3 metrics through a preregistered hypothesis-experiment-observation loop using identical 211 Angstrom four-image inputs, original folds and forecast windows for every comparator. Search primary literature after each experiment and use only training-side validation plus that literature to motivate the next hypothesis. Compare against the matched WindNet port and fixed M6, M10 and M13 controls. Preserve all negative, inconclusive and technical-failure results. Keep RogNet, GitHub and the existing dashboard synchronized. Source repository: https://github.com/kahirhumibntwerag/windnet-low-cost-study .
registration.constraints: Training development is restricted to original Folds 1-4: 108 original development blocks, 13 fitting and 14 validation windows per block, 1512 training-bank validation rows. Stream/hash/discard Fold5; never inspect or retain its images, labels, individual predictions or residuals during development. Never use any prior historical holdout scores, predictions or residuals to choose hypotheses or replace a frozen primary. Creating this campaign does not make previously evaluated historical data a fresh blind test. All comparators use the same predictor information, fitting data, evaluation rows, H4/D3 alignment and original metric implementations, including batchwise HSE threat score. No extra wavelengths, in-situ histories, persistence inputs, solar indices or external labels. Register complete candidate panels, ablations, seeds and success criteria and freeze source/data provenance before scoring. Do not move or duplicate prior experiments as newly executed work. Do not use Elicit. Use Runpod only within the existing cumulative US$5 study budget; the new campaign does not reset that budget. Preserve the dashboard's existing audience. Public campaign and code are authorized; never publish secrets, raw protected holdout data or the local manuscript.
registration.stop_conditions: No compute is launched by campaign creation. Before later execution, confirm cumulative costs from the recorded cost files and preregister the experiment. Stop compute before the original cumulative US$5 cap and delete only resources created for this study after downloading and verifying evidence. Retain M13 unless a candidate passes every frozen training-side adoption requirement. Final historical evaluation requires a frozen training-qualified recipe and sealed evaluator; report historical reuse explicitly and never adapt from final-test feedback. A numerical win alone is not evidence of causal or statistical superiority.

metric.name: Balanced four-metric training-side adoption
metric.evaluation_protocol: Four training-bank CV splits on original Folds 1-4 with identical original rows and four fixed controls: matched WindNet port, M6, M10 and M13. Aggregate RMSE by mean fold, correlation by Fisher-z mean, reduced chi-squared by mean fold, and HSE threat score with the original batchwise implementation. A candidate must have RMSE <=0.99 times the minimum control RMSE; correlation >= maximum control correlation +0.005; chi-squared <=0.995 times the minimum control chi-squared; and HSE threat score >= maximum control threat score +0.02. It must also pass at least 3 of 4 leave-one-fold-out directional comparisons, have every fold RMSE <=1.05 times the best control fold RMSE, and have the lower endpoint of a paired whole-block 2000-draw 95% HSE improvement interval strictly above zero against each of all four controls. Undefined metrics fail. Examine numerical candidates in ascending RMSE order. Gate=1 only after all requirements pass; otherwise gate=0 and retain M13. Report complete metric tuples, all ablations, uncertainty, repeated-validation limitations and failure reasons separately. This training gate must never be relabeled as historical-test performance.
